description: Bring memories to life with the TintLoop Snap, Print, Play! Instant Digital Camera - where creativity meets technology. This smart instant camera lets you capture photos and videos and print black & white pictures in seconds, all without using ink. Thanks to inkless thermal printing, you save money, avoid mess, and enjoy child-safe operation. The 2.4-inch colour display makes framing and viewing easy, while built-in games and music playback add an extra layer of entertainment. Every printed photo becomes more than just a picture - it’s a creative keepsake. Use the included sketch pens to colour, decorate, or personalise prints for scrapbooks, journals, school projects, or DIY gifts. Designed with a compact, sturdy build, the TintLoop camera is perfect for kids, yet stylish and fun for adults. Whether it’s a birthday party, vacation, playdate, or everyday moment, TintLoop helps you turn screen time into creative time. Available in Pastel Pink and Sky Blue, this instant camera makes a thoughtful gift for birthdays, festivals, return gifts, or creative minds of any age. ✨ Click. Print. Colour. Keep.
